title: A Hexanuclear Niobium Cluster Compound With Intra‐Cluster Chelate Ligands: [Nb<sub>6</sub>(OC<sub>2</sub>H<sub>4</sub>NH<sub>2</sub>)<sub>12</sub>]I<sub>3</sub>
abstract: AbstractFrom the reaction of [Nb6I11] with 2‐aminoethanol in pyridine the cluster compound [Nb6(OC2H4NH2)12]I3 has been obtained and the single‐crystal X‐ray structure determined. It represents the first example of a group VB metal cluster compound with hexanuclear, octahedral metal atom core, which carries intra‐cluster chelate ligands. With the formation of this unprecedented cluster cation we report for the first time a transformation of a 6–8 to a 6–12 type cluster unit. The formation of the cluster cation goes along with a one‐electron oxidation of the cluster starting material. Furthermore, it adds a second entry to the so far very small group of M6 cluster compounds with organic ligands on the inner cluster sites.
